The guardians are currently deciphering the symbols and incantations etched upon these sacred items.

As for your path forward, dear guardian, it is wise to stay vigilant and harness the knowledge shared at the conclave. Continue to strengthen your connection to the arcane forces and prepare for a time when the guardians must stand as one against the darkness that seeks to unravel the threads of fate.
